gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The positive HCP edit floor is materially relevant, but the source requirement includes a named field-level boundary: the patient's MID must not be editable. The proposed atom permits editPatientData for any HCP/Patient without any way to exclude MID edits. The validated schema/action lacks an edited-field or data-field context hook for editPatientData, so this cannot be repaired as a scoped property without a schema change.

proposed_atoms.name: editPatientData
proposed_atoms.rationale: The editPatientData action needs request context identifying which patient data field is being edited so policies can exclude MID edits.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: This lets an HCP edit patient data while making clear which field the HCP is trying to change.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: The HCP can edit patient data according to the data format, but the patient's MID must not be editable.

editedField.name: editPatientData__context__editedField
editedField.rationale: The edited field name is required to distinguish MID edits from other patient-data edits.
editedField.plain_english_summary: The request says which patient data field is being edited.

gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The atom targets a real uncovered requirement and uses the existing context.hospitals payload, but it replaces the source's named 'multiple hospitals' boundary with a weaker nonempty-set proxy. `context.hospitals.containsAny(context.hospitals)` only distinguishes empty from nonempty and does not express that the administrator may assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals. If the intended property is about the chosen/requested hospital payload, repair it without inventing a nonempty-only boundary; if the property must enforce true multiplicity, the validated schema/Cedar hook lacks a cardinality/count boundary for the hospital set.

proposed_atoms.name: assignLHCPToHospitals
proposed_atoms.rationale: Adds an explicit request-time multiplicity flag so policies can distinguish assigning multiple hospitals from assigning only one hospital.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: This captures whether the administrator's hospital assignment request includes multiple hospitals.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: The administrator can assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals and choose the hospitals.

assignsMultipleHospitals.name: assignLHCPToHospitals__context__assignsMultipleHospitals
assignsMultipleHospitals.rationale: Cedar sets do not expose cardinality, so this context field represents the named multiple-hospitals boundary directly.
assignsMultipleHospitals.plain_english_summary: True when the request is to assign the LHCP to more than one hospital.
assignsMultipleHospitals.source_excerpt: The administrator can assign an LHCP to multiple hospitals and choose the hospitals.
